runners_data.name: Star Of Jupiter
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer in excellent recent form with a second last time who should benefit from any injection of pace in the closing stages.

races.paceDynamic: This race lacks any genuine pace-setters with all seven runners classified as hold-up performers, creating an artificial early tempo. Stitching Wheel appears most likely to be forced into an unwilling lead role given the tactical makeup, but will be looking to come back to the field. The absence of natural front-runners means the early gallop will be pedestrian before developing into a tactical affair. This race shape strongly favours horses with the best turn of foot who can quicken off the steady tempo, giving prominent racers and those comfortable tracking the pace a significant advantage over pure hold-up horses.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Slow Burn Kick
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays pedestrian throughout with no one willing to commit early
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where horses with the best acceleration benefit from the crawling gallop. Those able to position closest to the modest pace gain crucial tactical advantages.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Mid Race Injection
scenarios.trigger: If Stitching Wheel or another runner decides to inject pace from the halfway stage
scenarios.body: This creates a more honest gallop that will stretch the field and favour horses with sustained stamina. The tactical complexion changes to reward those who can travel strongly into contention.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Messy Tactical Affair
scenarios.trigger: If multiple horses refuse to commit and the pace remains crawling to the final three furlongs
scenarios.body: The race becomes a chaotic sprint where positioning and racing room become critical factors. Jockey tactics and draw advantages prove decisive in the scramble.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Early Breakaway Works
scenarios.trigger: If Stitching Wheel commits to a genuine front-running effort and maintains the advantage
scenarios.body: The lone pace-setter gets an uncontested lead and proves difficult to peg back on the long straight. Hold-up horses struggle to make up the ground despite the modest gallop.

watchPoints.text: All seven runners are classified as hold-up performers creating an artificial pace scenario where positioning becomes critical.
Stitching Wheel may be forced into an unwilling lead role which could compromise the horse's natural running style and effectiveness.
Star Of Jupiter carries significant apprentice weight reduction with Hope Regan's 7lb claim potentially providing a crucial advantage.
The 19-day gap since last run for Angelardo, Star Of Jupiter and Nymphaea suggests these three arrive fresh and ready to improve.
Lady Phoebe's recent course success over this distance makes the mare particularly interesting despite the longer absence.

runners_data.name: Ticker Tape
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist from powerful Gosden yard with proven ability to finish strongly at this distance.

runners_data.name: Maneater

races.paceDynamic: Maneater will take this field along as the sole confirmed front-runner, with La Tosca likely to settle prominently in second. The pace should be sustainable rather than fierce given limited early speed, allowing the quartet of hold-up horses (Littlecote, Ticker Tape, The Lakes) plus the two unknowns (Danseuse, Hello Friend) to get into contention. With one leader creating a steady gallop over this staying trip, this race shape strongly favours horses that can finish from off the pace, particularly those with proven hold-up tactics.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Maneater sets a steady pace without pressure from La Tosca
scenarios.body: The lack of early speed allows closers to position perfectly and unleash late runs, with Littlecote and Ticker Tape having proven finishing kicks at this trip. Hold-up specialists benefit most from the predictable, sustainable gallop.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pair Control
scenarios.trigger: If La Tosca applies early pressure to Maneater creating a genuine pace duel
scenarios.body: The two early leaders tire in the final furlong after a testing gallop, but their honest pace still sets up the race for late runners rather than rewarding front-running tactics. Late closers still benefit but need to work harder.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Sustains
scenarios.trigger: If Maneater gets completely uncontested fractions with La Tosca settling further back than expected
scenarios.body: The leader builds an unassailable advantage through crawling sectionals, making it impossible for hold-up horses to reel in despite their preferred running style. Maneater's stamina reserves prove decisive.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise Package Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If either Danseuse or Hello Friend shows unexpectedly sharp early speed to challenge the pace
scenarios.body: The race develops into a three-way speed battle that completely changes the complexion, creating perfect conditions for the remaining hold-up horses to sweep past tired leaders. Unknown quantities cause tactical chaos.

watchPoints.text: Maneater's fitness after 180-day absence could see the front-runner weaken dramatically in final furlong
La Tosca's early positioning crucial as only realistic pace challenger to prevent crawling fractions
Danseuse and Hello Friend's early tactical moves will reveal their true running styles for first time
Littlecote's consistency at trip suggests strong each-way claims if pace develops as expected
Jockey instructions for Ticker Tape will indicate Gosden team's confidence levels after recent runs

races.paceDynamic: Zain Primus looks the lone pace angle with his prominent style, likely to dictate terms from the front without serious pressure. The majority of the field are hold-up horses (Gold Digger, Spaceman, The Cyprus Pearl, Qila, April Diamond, Forest Phoenix) who will need to rely on finishing kicks. Project Wallace's style is unknown but carries the highest rating at OR 120, while the pace scenario should create a tactical race where positioning will be crucial. This shape strongly favours early pace and prominent runners who can avoid the traffic problems that will inevitably affect the large hold-up contingent.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Zain Controls Uncontested
scenarios.trigger: If Zain Primus gets an easy lead without early challenges
scenarios.body: He can dictate fractions and kick clear when the hold-up horses are still organizing behind him. The weight of numbers behind creates interference and late traffic, making his position ideal.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Project Wallace Class Tells
scenarios.trigger: If the highest-rated runner can secure a decent position early
scenarios.body: His OR 120 advantage becomes decisive in a slowly-run race where pure ability matters more than tactics. Unknown style could mean he's more versatile than the pure hold-up horses.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Hero Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and becomes a sprint finish
scenarios.body: One of the better hold-up horses like Gold Digger or Spaceman gets a dream run through and capitalizes on superior finishing speed. Traffic needs to part perfectly for this group.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Longshot Chaos Special
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is genuinely strong and the favorites hit trouble
scenarios.body: Lesser lights like Roy Lane or Qila benefit from a truly-run race that exposes stamina doubts in others. Requires everything to fall right for the outsiders.

watchPoints.text: Project Wallace's running style early - if he shows early speed alongside Zain Primus, it changes the entire complexion
Traffic problems at the furlong pole with so many hold-up horses converging simultaneously from the rear
Zain Primus getting an uncontested lead through the first two furlongs - crucial for his winning chances
Gold Digger and Spaceman's fitness levels after extended breaks, both need to be cherry-ripe first time back
The pace through halfway - if it's genuinely strong it will suit the closers, if slow it plays to early speed

races.paceDynamic: Brave Traveller will lead with no obvious challenger, creating a moderate gallop rather than breakneck speed. The real battle develops behind as Houndhill, Golden Havana, Mystical Land, Oasis Cover, and Ryefield all want prominent positions within the first three lengths. This creates a bunched, competitive group tracking the leader with potential for interference when they fan out 2-3f from home. The assured pace and lack of early pressure strongly favours hold-up horses like Zoustar Dreams and Everydaysasaturday who can pick off tired leaders.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses prosper
scenarios.trigger: If Brave Traveller maintains a steady gallop and the prominent group stays bunched
scenarios.body: The pace becomes truly-run allowing closers to unleash finishing kicks while the early positioned horses get caught in traffic or tire from jostling. Zoustar Dreams and Everydaysasaturday benefit most from the tactical advantage.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front group survives
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent horses settle better than expected and avoid early interference
scenarios.body: Golden Havana and Houndhill use their class to stay clear of trouble while still getting competitive positioning. The moderate pace doesn't drain them before the final furlong.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Leader dominates throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Brave Traveller gets completely uncontested fractions and kicks clear early in the straight
scenarios.body: The lack of pressure allows the leader to dictate completely and the chasing pack fails to organize effectively. Brave Traveller proves hard to peg back despite the closing kick specialists.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace collapses completely
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent group goes too slow trying to avoid early positioning battles
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from the 2f pole where pure speed trumps tactical positioning. This suits horses with natural gate speed who can quicken despite their prominent style.

races.paceDynamic: Blue Nguru and Maldevious will ensure a genuine gallop from the start, both confirmed front-runners who won't give an inch early. With only two natural leaders in a nine-runner field, they'll likely go at a sustainable clip rather than suicidal fractions, creating an honest tempo throughout. The majority hold-up runners (Hen Party, Fizzy Cristal, Concert, Annie Edson Taylor, Perfect Price) will be tracking behind this genuine pace. This race shape strongly favours the prominent racers and closers who can capitalize on the even gallop set by the two leaders.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustainable Pace Setup
scenarios.trigger: If Blue Nguru and Maldevious settle into a steady rhythm without over-racing early
scenarios.body: The honest gallop allows hold-up horses to get into contention while the pace-setters remain competitive late. Hollie Doyle's tactical nous on Blue Nguru could prove decisive as the race develops into a proper sprint finish.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Duel
scenarios.trigger: If Blue Nguru and Maldevious engage in a prolonged battle for the lead through halfway
scenarios.body: The pace quickens beyond sustainable levels, setting up the race perfectly for the numerous hold-up runners to sweep past the weakened leaders. Fizzy Cristal's proven course form and tactical speed become major assets.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Too Much can secure the ideal position tracking the two leaders without being trapped
scenarios.body: The only prominent runner gets first run on the field while the hold-up horses are still making their moves. Too Much's versatile style allows exploitation of the tactical scenario despite recent inconsistency.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Late Closer Swoop
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes genuinely strong and the field spreads out significantly
scenarios.body: The extreme hold-up horses get maximum assistance from a truly-run race with plenty of room to maneuver late. Concert's headgear change suggests connections expect improved finishing kick from this tactical position.

races.paceDynamic: Lord Capulet and Blazing Son are both confirmed front-runners who will contest the early lead, creating a genuine pace battle from the start. This honest gallop will stretch the field and create a searching test over 7f on the Tapeta surface. The strong early pace will set up the race for horses with prominent or hold-up styles who can pick up the pieces. This race shape clearly favours hold-up horses and those who can finish strongly, as the pace-setters are likely to soften each other up.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Early Pace
scenarios.trigger: If Lord Capulet and Blazing Son engage in a sustained battle through the first 4f
scenarios.body: The genuine gallop will find out the front-runners and create the perfect scenario for closers to strike. Hold-up horses like The Green Man, King's School and Atmosphere will have ideal conditions to unleash their finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Moderate Tempo
scenarios.trigger: If one of the leaders gets an easy time by going clear early
scenarios.body: The pace will be less demanding allowing Lord Capulet or prominent runners to have enough left for the finish. Horses racing prominently like Red Mirage and Criminal Shore can stay competitive throughout.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Messy Early Scrimmaging
scenarios.trigger: If the pace battle involves multiple horses fighting for position early
scenarios.body: The interference and uneven gallop will favour experienced campaigners who can adapt and find clear running. Patient hold-up horses with tactical speed will benefit most from the chaos.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Tactical Crawl
scenarios.trigger: If both leaders show restraint and allow the pace to slacken significantly
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where raw speed matters most, suiting horses with tactical pace who can quicken sharply. Those drawn well with finishing speed will have the advantage.
